speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: The Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) seeks to build a caring, cohesive and confident nation.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: We can take pride in our progress, anchored on shared values that define us as Singaporeans.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: Our cohesion makes us exceptional and will remain vital as we look ahead to the future.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: MCCY will work with Singaporeans to expand our common space, realise aspirations and nurture a “We First” society.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: In a divided world, multiculturalism is more important than ever.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: MCCY will protect spaces for everyone to freely practise their beliefs, while working with our Harmony Circles and network of inter-faith partners to deepen understanding and appreciation among people of all races and religions.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: We will mobilise Singaporeans, especially youths, to participate and lead in interfaith and intercultural exchanges.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: Our culture, expressed through our arts and heritage, defines who we are and projects our values to the world.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: Sports bring Singaporeans from all walks of life together and foster inclusion.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: With the completion of Outward Bound Singapore at Coney Island, more secondary school students will be able to interact and bond with peers from different backgrounds.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: With the refresh of *SCAPE and development of Somerset Belt, the National Youth Council (NYC) will expand programmes for youths to meet, collaborate and bond.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: We will empower artists to pursue their passion and reach their full potential.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: The expanded National Arts Council scholarships enable youths to pursue programmes in the School of the Arts as well as in diploma and degree programmes.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: We will also expand workplace training for arts administrators and technical professionals.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: We have introduced the spexEducation Undergraduate Scholarships and will rally corporates to provide athlete-friendly workplaces.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: We will integrate the High Performance Sport Institute and Singapore Sports School to strengthen end-to-end athlete development, while working in partnership with our National Sports Associations.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: The Plan will connect youths, amplify their voice and give them a say in shaping policies and programmes.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: We will foster a “We First” society, where those who have done well give back and where success is measured by how we uplift others.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: Our Collective for a Stronger Society brings together Government agencies, community partners and donors to support lower-income families and encourages donors to volunteer and offer their networks to support beneficiaries.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: To build a democracy of deeds, MCCY will create more space for citizens and community stakeholders to propose and implement new solutions.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: The Singapore Government Partnerships Office will expand citizen engagement and partnerships for a more participatory future, while the People’s Association will engage residents through the Community Volunteer Scheme and equip community leaders to grow more micro-communities of care across Singapore.

speaker: The Acting Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr David Neo)
text: Together with all Singaporeans, MCCY will shape a future where every person has a stake and every deed helps build a stronger Singapore.
